# Third-party assets — Poly Haven (CC0 1.0)

All files under this folder were downloaded from https://polyhaven.com and are released under
the CC0 1.0 Universal public-domain dedication (no attribution required; credited here as courtesy).

Ground textures : sparse_grass, brown_mud_leaves_01, rocky_trail, forest_ground_04, aerial_rocks_02,
                  burned_ground_01, ground_grey, dark_rock_02, dark_rock
Models          : rock_face_01, rock_face_02, namaqualand_cliff_01, boulder_01, namaqualand_boulder_05,
                  rock_07, rock_09, moon_rock_01/02/04/06, dead_tree_trunk_02, tree_stump_01, fern_02,
                  old_tyre, metal_jerrycan, wooden_crate_01, old_military_crate, propane_tank
Foliage sources : fir_tree_01 (twig atlas), pine_tree_01 (bark), grass_medium_01 (grass card atlas)
Sky             : kloofendal_38d_partly_cloudy_puresky (HDRI)

Source files are kept unmodified. Derived textures (packed mask maps, branch/grass card atlases)
are generated by the Cinder Pass editor tooling into Assets/CinderPass/Art/Generated.
